primitives.name: p0171 Operator 1
primitives.verbatim_quote: 142 AMERICAN FOOTBALL PaSsING FrOM OpEn FOrMAtION It often happens that the offense has great difficulty in getting off its passes from the close formation.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_{pass|close}': 'Probability of successful forward pass from close formation (dimensionless)', 'P_{pass|open}': 'Probability of successful forward pass from open formation (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Assumes fixed quarterback skill, constant defense alignment, and identical receiver availability across both formations.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs when defense aggressively compresses space in close formation, rendering P_{pass|close} → 0 while P_{pass|open} remains finite.

layer2.telemetry: Quarterback completion percentage differential between open and close formations, adjusted for down, distance, and defender proximity.
